prescriptions_cancel_check.name: prescriptions_cancel_check
prescriptions_cancel_check.value: "prescriptions"."status" <> 'cancelada' or ("prescriptions"."cancel_reason" is not null and "prescriptions"."cancelled_at" is not null and "prescriptions"."cancelled_by" is not null)

users_medico_crm_check.name: users_medico_crm_check
users_medico_crm_check.value: "users"."role" <> 'medico' or ("users"."crm" is not null and "users"."crm_uf" is not null)
